mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_version, payload::text AS payload, correlation_id, status, attempt_count, created_at, published_at, next_attempt_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_version, payload, correlation_id, status, attempt_count, created_at, published_at, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{eventVersion}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{correlationId}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{nextAttemptAt} )
mapper.select: UPDATE outbox_events target SET next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil} FROM ( SELECT id FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize} ) claimed WHERE target.id = claimed.id RETURNING target.id, target.aggregate_type, target.aggregate_id, target.event_type, target.event_version, target.payload::text AS payload, target.correlation_id, target.status, target.attempt_count, target.created_at, target.published_at, target.next_attempt_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'PENDING'
